## [3.0.1](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/compare/v3.0.0...v3.0.1) (2026-11-14)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* request IMDb trivia in English on all system languages ([086e684](https://github.com/mvaishak/letterboxd-morphe-patches/commit/086e6847a4b039fbe0d90d8c6bef6c751076947b))

patches.name: Adult posters
patches.description: Adds a Mods setting to show unblurred adult film posters supplied by Letterboxd.

patches.name: Appearance
patches.description: In-app appearance controls, adjustable from the Letterboxd Mods screen without re-patching: a true-black OLED surface, a custom accent colour (presets or any hex), and the bottom-navigation selected style. Applied at runtime via resource overlays on Android 12 and later. Needs the "Mod settings" patch. If the separate "Material You theme" patch is also applied, its OLED and nav-bar-match switches are disabled here automatically — the two theming systems can't run at once.

patches.name: Brighter Watched-by stars
patches.description: Other people's star ratings in a film's "Watched by" row use a very dark grey (#445566) that is hard to read, especially on a black theme. This switches them to the lighter grey (#99AABB) the rest of the app already uses for other people's ratings. A small legibility fix, on by default.

patches.name: Change app icon
patches.description: Choose a built-in Letterboxd launcher icon from the App icon settings.

patches.name: Copy lists
patches.description: Use Clone in a list's More menu to save an independent copy with the films in order.

patches.name: Custom artwork
patches.description: Choose local posters and backdrops from TMDB or an image URL, independently of your Letterboxd subscription.

patches.name: Denser poster grid
patches.description: Tightens the spacing around posters in grids so they render larger and closer together. Does not change the number of columns.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Stops the Google AdMob banners shown to free accounts from loading anywhere in the app. On by default.

patches.name: Hide sponsored content
patches.description: Hides Letterboxd's sponsored Spotlight / featured-trailer card on the Films home tab, including its space. Toggle it in Mod settings. On by default.

patches.name: IMDb trivia (personal)
patches.description: Shows categorized IMDb trivia for the current film. Enable only for authorized personal use.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Repaints Letterboxd's dark chrome — window background, surfaces, cards, the top bar, tab strip, bottom nav and sheets — from the device's Material You palette on Android 12+ (no effect below). No accent or OLED options here; those live in the "Mod settings" screen — but that screen's "Pure black (OLED)" and "Match bottom nav" switches turn themselves off while this patch is applied, since it already repaints those surfaces on its own. No effect on Jetpack Compose screens.

patches.name: Mod settings
patches.description: HOW TO OPEN: long-press the settings gear on your profile tab. — This adds a "Letterboxd Mods" screen that collects the other patches' options (theme, accent, hide ratings, hide video store, hide where to watch, open in player, match bottom nav, etc.) so you can change them inside the app instead of re-patching. Some changes apply immediately, others after a restart, and you'll be prompted either way.

options.description: How the hidden rating is covered, before you've changed it from the Mods screen. 'Frosted panel' is an opaque panel with an eye glyph; 'Tap-to-show link' is a plain text link under the section title; 'Shimmer' is a continuously animating particle field; 'Tap to burst' is a static particle field that scatters when tapped. The Mods screen also has a separate "Reveal animation" (default / crumble / confetti) that changes how tapping any of the three opaque covers disappears, independent of which one you pick here.

patches.name: Profile badge
patches.description: Preview a Pro, Patron, or custom badge on your own profile on this device.

patches.name: Rating slider haptics
patches.description: Feel a light tick at each half-star step as you drag the rating slider.

patches.name: Smooth film credits tabs
patches.description: Shows already-loaded cast and crew credits immediately when switching film detail tabs.
